description: Loom's own webviews, and deliberately NOT the pages the browser shows. Matched on `webviews` rather than `windows` because Tauri matches a capability as `webviews.matches(webview) || windows.matches(window)` — an OR — so naming a window would grant every webview inside it. Since each browser tab is a child webview of the window showing the panel, a `windows` list here would have handed a real remote web page Loom's whole IPC surface. A WebviewWindow's webview label is its window label, so this changes nothing for Loom's own windows and excludes every tab (named loom-tab-<id>).
